title: Salmon: A Link in the Food Chain
titleZh: 三文鱼：食物链中的一环

q.en: In the adult salmon's food chain described in the book, what does a salmon get eaten by?
q.zh: 书中描述的三文鱼（成鱼）食物链里，三文鱼会被什么吃掉？

options.en: A human, a bear, a killer whale, a seal, or an eagle
options.zh: 人、熊、虎鲸、海豹或老鹰

options.en: Only plants
options.zh: 只有植物

options.en: Only plankton
options.zh: 只有浮游生物

options.en: Only other salmon because adult salmon are known to eat their own kind when food is scarce
options.zh: 只有其他三文鱼因为食物短缺时，成年三文鱼会吃同类

explain.en: The book says a salmon 'may be eaten by a human, a bear, a killer whale, a seal, or an eagle.'
explain.zh: 书里写道，三文鱼「可能被人类、熊、虎鲸、海豹或老鹰吃掉」

q.en: Where do salmon lay their eggs, and what kind of water do they need?
q.zh: 三文鱼把卵产在哪里？它们需要什么样的水？

options.en: In a bird's nest
options.zh: 在鸟巢里

options.en: In the warm, polluted ocean
options.zh: 在温暖而受污染的海里

options.en: On top of rocks in the hot desert where the sun kept the eggs warm until they hatched into tiny fish
options.zh: 在炎热沙漠的岩石上太阳把卵晒得暖暖的，直到孵出小鱼

options.en: In the gravel of a riverbed or streambed, in cold, clean water
options.zh: 在河床或溪床的砾石里，需要冰冷干净的水

explain.en: The book says salmon 'begin as tiny eggs laid in the gravel of a riverbed or streambed' and 'need cold, clean water in order to lay and fertilize eggs.'
explain.zh: 书里说三文鱼「始于产在河床或溪床砾石里的微小卵」，并且「需要冰冷干净的水来产卵和受精」

q.en: After leaving the estuary, how long do adult salmon live and feed in the ocean?
q.zh: 离开河口后，成年三文鱼在海洋里生活、觅食多久？

options.en: For about fifty years
options.zh: 约五十年

options.en: For only a few days
options.zh: 只有几天

options.en: For one to seven years, traveling thousands of miles
options.zh: 一到七年，游动数千英里

options.en: For their whole lives, they never leave and they return to the exact river where they were born only after they die
options.zh: 一生都不离开而且它们只在死后才回到出生的那条河

explain.en: The book says adult salmon 'live and feed on smaller fish in the ocean for one to seven years, traveling thousands of miles.'
explain.zh: 书里说成年三文鱼「在海洋中以较小的鱼为食生活一到七年，游动数千英里」

q.en: In the glossary, what is an 'estuary'?
q.zh: 在词汇表里，「estuary」（河口）是什么？

options.en: A deep part of the open ocean
options.zh: 开阔海洋的深处

options.en: A type of dam built by humans which engineers open and close to control how much salt enters the sea
options.zh: 人类修建的一种水坝工程师通过开合它来控制进入海洋的盐量

options.en: The part of a river where fresh water mixes with the ocean's salt water (brackish)
options.zh: 河流中淡水与海水混合（变成微咸水）的那一段

options.en: A nest where salmon lay eggs
options.zh: 三文鱼产卵的巢

explain.en: The glossary defines an estuary as 'the part of a river where the fresh water mixes with the ocean's salt water' — the smolts prepare there for the ocean
explain.zh: 词汇表把 estuary 定义为「河流中淡水与海水混合的那一段」——小鱼在那里为进入海洋做准备

q.en: According to the glossary, what are 'alevins'?

options.en: Adult salmon that swim in the ocean and they are the ones that swim out to the open ocean to spawn
options.zh: 在海洋里游的成年三文鱼而且正是它们游向开阔海洋去产卵

options.en: The eggs before they hatch
options.zh: 孵化前的卵

options.en: A kind of plankton
options.zh: 一种浮游生物

options.en: Baby salmon that have a food sac on their underbelly
options.zh: 肚子下面带着食物囊的幼小三文鱼

explain.en: The glossary defines alevins as 'baby salmon that have a food sac on their underbelly' (the stage right after hatching)
explain.zh: 词汇表把 alevins 定义为「肚子下面带着食物囊的幼小三文鱼」（刚孵化后的阶段）

q.en: In the glossary, what does 'spawn' mean?
q.zh: 在词汇表里，「spawn」是什么意思？

options.en: To change color
options.zh: 变色

options.en: To swim upstream quickly
options.zh: 快速逆流而上

options.en: To eat other fish and the word is only used for fish that hunt near the surface
options.zh: 吃其他鱼而且这个词只用来指在水面附近捕食的鱼

options.en: To reproduce and lay eggs
options.zh: 繁殖并产卵

explain.en: The glossary defines spawn as 'reproduce and lay eggs' — the return trip salmon make to lay and fertilize eggs
explain.zh: 词汇表把 spawn 定义为「繁殖并产卵」——三文鱼返乡产卵受精的旅程

q.en: The book explains that estuaries can become polluted with chemicals. What happens to a bird as a result?
q.zh: 书中说河口可能被化学物质污染。这会导致鸟怎样？

options.en: The bird learns to avoid the water
options.zh: 鸟学会避开那片水

options.en: The chemicals turn the bird into a fish
options.zh: 化学物质把鸟变成了鱼

options.en: The smolt absorbs the chemicals, and when a bird eats the smolt, the bird becomes poisoned
options.zh: 小鱼吸收了化学物质，鸟吃掉小鱼后就会中毒

options.en: The bird grows larger and stronger and within a week it becomes the largest bird in the whole river
options.zh: 鸟变得更大更强壮而且一周之内它就变成了整条河里最大的鸟

explain.en: The book says if a smolt 'absorbs pollution into its body and then a bird eats the smolt, the bird becomes poisoned' — one link harming the next
explain.zh: 书里说，如果小鱼「把污染吸进体内，随后鸟吃掉小鱼，鸟就会中毒」——链条上一环受损，下一环也受害

q.en: After spawners lay eggs and die about a week later, how do their bodies help the life cycle begin again?
q.zh: 产卵者产完卵、约一周后死去，它们的身体如何帮助生命循环重新开始？

options.en: They are eaten only by humans
options.zh: 只被人类吃掉

options.en: They are frozen and saved for later so scientists can study them in a lab during the next winter
options.zh: 被冷冻保存起来这样科学家能在来年冬天在实验室研究它们

options.en: They turn into new rivers
options.zh: 变成了新的河流

options.en: Their decomposing bodies fertilize the stream and feed plankton
options.zh: 它们腐烂的尸体为溪流施肥，并成为浮游生物的食物

explain.en: The book says the decomposing salmon 'fertilize the stream' and their 'flesh and bones also provide food for plankton,' restarting the cycle
explain.zh: 书里说腐烂的三文鱼「为溪流施肥」，其「肉和骨头也成为浮游生物的食物」，让生命循环重新开始

q.en: What big idea does the author want readers to understand about food chains?
q.zh: 关于食物链，作者最想让读者明白的核心观点是什么？

options.en: Harming one living thing in a food chain harms the other living things connected to it
options.zh: 伤害食物链中的某一个生物，就会伤害与它相连的其他生物

options.en: Only the biggest animal matters in a food chain
options.zh: 食物链里只有最大的动物才重要

options.en: Food chains never change
options.zh: 食物链永远不变

options.en: Salmon are the only important link because every other creature in the ocean depends only on salmon to live
options.zh: 三文鱼是唯一重要的一环因为海洋里所有其他生物都只靠三文鱼生存

explain.en: The book repeats that salmon are links in many food chains and 'Harming one living thing in a food chain harms other living things in the chain.'
explain.zh: 书里反复强调三文鱼是许多食物链中的一环，而「伤害食物链中的某一个生物，就会伤害链条上的其他生物」

q.en: Why does the author describe the salmon's whole life — from egg to ocean to spawning to death?
q.zh: 作者为什么要描述三文鱼完整的一生——从卵、海洋、产卵到死亡？

options.en: To encourage people to eat more salmon
options.zh: 为了鼓励人们多吃三文鱼

options.en: To show how interconnected salmon are with other animals and their environment at every stage
options.zh: 为了展现三文鱼在每一个阶段都与其他动物和环境紧密相连

options.en: To list every country salmon visit
options.zh: 为了列出三文鱼去过的每个国家

options.en: To prove salmon are the smartest fish and the book gives them high scores on tests meant for dolphins
options.zh: 为了证明三文鱼是最聪明的鱼而且书里还让他们在给海豚做的测试中拿了高分

explain.en: The book says you will 'learn about the salmon life cycle and about all the ways they are interconnected with other animals and with their environment,' showing the author's purpose
explain.zh: 书里说你会「了解三文鱼的生命周期，以及它们与其他动物和环境相连的各种方式」，正体现了作者的写作目的

prompt.en: The book shows that salmon connect many living things — plankton, herring, bears, eagles, humans — and that harming one link affects the others. Think of a food chain you know (in the ocean, a forest, or even a backyard). What are its links, and what might happen if one of them disappeared or was harmed? Why does understanding food chains matter?
prompt.zh: 书中展示了三文鱼连接了许多生物——浮游生物、鲱鱼、熊、老鹰、人类——而且伤害其中一环就会影响其他环。想一想你知道的某条食物链（海洋里、森林里，甚至后院里）。它由哪些环节组成？如果其中一个环节消失或受损，会发生什么？理解食物链为什么重要？

en: Salmon link plankton -> herring -> salmon -> bears/eagles/humans; harming one link harms the others (p. 4-5)
Pollution in an estuary can poison a bird that eats an affected smolt (p. 12)
A good answer names a real food chain, predicts the effect of losing one link, and explains why the connections matter
zh: 三文鱼连接着 浮游生物 → 鲱鱼 → 三文鱼 → 熊/老鹰/人类；伤害一环就会伤害其他环（第4-5页）
河口的污染会让吃掉受影响小鱼的鸟中毒（第12页）
好的回答会说出一条真实的食物链，预测失去一环的后果，并解释这种联系为何重要
